patterns.root_cause: LB ID invalid or LB deleted
patterns.prevention: Cache LB ID at provisioning time

patterns.root_cause: Backend instance health check failing: port blocked, app down, or SG mismatch

fix.action: Inspect backend: hcloud ELB listMembers --lb_id {{output.lb_id}}; check SG allows LB->backend traffic on health-check port

patterns.prevention: Validate SG rules + health-check port at LB add time

patterns.root_cause: Port already used by another listener on same LB

fix.action: hcloud ELB listListeners --lb_id {{output.lb_id}}; pick unused port
Delegate to huaweicloud-iam-ops for quota raise

patterns.prevention: Check quota via showQuota before bulk LB ops

patterns.root_cause: LB subnet does not exist or in different VPC than backend

fix.action: Delegate to huaweicloud-vpc-ops to verify subnet; ensure LB subnet + backend subnet share VPC

patterns.prevention: Validate LB subnet + backend subnet VPC alignment

patterns.root_cause: API rate limit on ELB control plane

fix.action: Exponential backoff with jitter; respect Retry-After

patterns.prevention: Throttle to <10 req/s for ELB API

patterns.root_cause: ELB HTTPS listener cert expired or uploaded wrong format

fix.action: Delegate to huaweicloud-kms-ops to upload new cert; update listener: hcloud ELB updateListener --cert_id {{output.new_cert_id}}

patterns.prevention: Alarm cert expiry at 30d via CES

fix.action: Clamp weight to 0..100; 0 means drain (no new connections)

patterns.prevention: Validate weight range client-side before submit

fix.action: Upgrade LB spec: hcloud ELB changeLoadbalancerChargeMode --lb_id {{output.lb_id}} --type payg

patterns.root_cause: Backend removal blocked by lingering connections past drain timeout

fix.action: Force remove after drain timeout: hcloud ELB batchRemoveMembers --lb_id {{output.lb_id}} --members {{output.member_ids}} --force

patterns.prevention: Tune connection-drain timeout to <300s; reduce stuck connections
